title_zh: WebXSkill：面向自主网页智能体的技能学习
one_line: WebXSkill mines parameterized skills with step-level guidance from synthetic trajectories, retrieves them via a URL graph, and improves WebArena, WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web success.
one_line_zh: 从合成轨迹中提炼带分步指引的参数化可执行技能，按URL图检索，在三个网页基准上提升成功率。

online_eval.quote: Online-Mind2Web ( Xue et al., 2025 ) adds 300 tasks across more than 100 live websites.

held_out_env.quote: Skills are extracted by SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) on synthetic tasks for each benchmark website.

strong_baselines.quote: (2) MAP (Multi-Action Prediction), which generates up to 3 browser actions per step; (3) SkillWeaver ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; and (4) WALT ( Prabhu et al., 2026 ) .

budget_matched.quote: All methods use a 30 interaction step budget.

cost_reported.quote: For step efficiency, Grounded mode achieves 9.3 average steps with higher success rate, fewer steps than Vanilla.

component_ablation.quote: Verification makes the largest contribution, while contextual organization and step-level guidance each provide substantial gains.

validator_check.quote: For benchmark evaluation, we follow the default settings by each benchmark and use GPT-4.1 if required for LLM judge.

code.quote: The code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebXSkill.

evidence_level.quote: We test it with only WebArena skills (Guided + WA) and it reaches 85.1% without target-site programs, a 10.7 point gain over MAP on WebVoyager

S1.quote: Skills are extracted by SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) on synthetic tasks for each benchmark website.

S2.quote: Verification makes the largest contribution, while contextual organization and step-level guidance each provide substantial gains.

S3.quote: Expanding from 25% of the corpus to the full set grows the library from 105 to 591 skills, raises task success from 62.8% to 69.5%, and increases UR from 26.6% to 70.8%.

S5.quote: Grounded mode reaches 86.1%, improving over Vanilla by 14.2 points and MAP by 11.7 on WebVoyager.

AP5.quote: Skills are extracted by SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) on synthetic tasks for each benchmark website.

AP8.quote: following recent work ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , we use its cleaned 154 task subset.

title_zh: 成功则快学，失败则慢学：面向移动应用控制的样本高效离策略强化学习
one_line: SoLS off-policy actor-critic updates fully on positive-advantage steps, conservatively on negative ones, with successful-transition replay; 51.3% on AndroidWorld with an 8B model.
one_line_zh: 离策略actor-critic对正优势样本直接更新、对负优势样本保守更新并回放成功步，8B模型在AndroidWorld达51.3%。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate SoLS on AndroidWorld [ 20 ] , a benchmark of real-world mobile app control tasks across three difficulty levels.

held_out_env.quote: In other categories, particularly Files, Maps, and Markor, the increase in success rate is very large, as the agent learns to solve tasks from these categories during exploration and reinforces them throughout training, especially with the help of STR.

variance.quote: For models that do not require proprietary access, we average results over three evaluation runs and report two standard errors for the overall success rate.

strong_baselines.quote: Among RL methods, DigiRL-STR achieves the highest performance among existing approaches with 38.8% overall success rate.

budget_matched.quote: To further highlight the contribution of our asymmetric update mechanism, we compare SoLS with standard A2C using identical STR parameters.

cost_reported.quote: SoLS occupies the best position in the bottom-right quadrant, achieving the highest success rate (51.3%) while maintaining the fastest inference time ( \sim 0.9 seconds).

component_ablation.quote: The results show that SoLS-STR improves upon A2C-STR by approximately 60% relative improvement (51.3% vs 32.1%).

evidence_level.quote: Our approach achieves an overall success rate of 51.3%, significantly outperforming both expensive GPT-4o-based approaches and other RL-based fine-tuning methods.

S1.quote: As a first step, we fine-tune our base model through SFT on AndroidControl, which shares observation and action space similarities with AndroidWorld.

S2.quote: We augment SoLS with Successful Transition Replay (STR), which prioritises learning from successful interactions, further improving sample efficiency.

F4.quote: In this work, we use Llama-3-8B-Instruct [ 12 ] for approximating the policy.

AP5.quote: In other categories, particularly Files, Maps, and Markor, the increase in success rate is very large, as the agent learns to solve tasks from these categories during exploration and reinforces them throughout training, especially with the help of STR.

title_zh: OmegaUse-SOP：基于人类演示的专业计算机使用SOP工程
one_line: OmegaUse-SOP records expert GUI demonstrations, abstracts them into semantic step instructions, and executes them as skills; 5/5 PVsyst tasks versus 1-3/5 baseline.
one_line_zh: 录制专家GUI演示并抽象为语义步骤指令，作为SOP技能执行，在PVsyst五项任务上全部通过。
